title: Proper pushforward preserves coherent cohomology over locally Noetherian bases
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof must reduce arbitrary coherent modules to suitable generically rank-one sheaves whose direct images are controlled. A Chow modification and a twist ample for two maps create such test objects with vanishing higher direct images, and relative Leray plus coherent devissage complete the finiteness argument.
